Calling All Classic Cars: Be Part of the Inaugural Mackinaw Steel Car Show

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:12
Instaread

The engines are warming up and excitement is building for Mackinaw Steel, a brand-new car show experience coming to Mackinaw City June 5-7. Set in one of Michigan’s most scenic destinations at the tip of the Lower Peninsula, this three-day event invites classic car owners, collectors, and enthusiasts to showcase their vehicles in a truly unforgettable setting.

If you have a car you’re proud of, Mackinaw Steel is your chance to display it, connect with fellow enthusiasts, and be a part of a first-year event designed to grow into a signature tradition in Northern Michigan.

A Full Weekend Built for Car Enthusiasts

Mackinaw Steel is more than just a one-day show — it is a complete weekend experience. Participants can arrive Friday for welcome night, early registration, and relaxed festivities with fellow car owners. Saturday features the formal judged show from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, followed by a parade through downtown Mackinaw City and evening entertainment. The weekend concludes Sunday morning with awards and roll-out.

Vehicles are only required to be present for the full show hours on Saturday, making it an easy and flexible event for both local and traveling participants.

Show Layout Designed to Showcase Every Vehicle

With over 300 parking spaces in the main lot and additional space for vendors and activities, the event is designed for visibility and accessibility. Spectators will be able to walk freely throughout the show grounds, ensuring strong engagement with participating vehicles all day long.

Classic and pre-1974 vehicles will be prominently displayed in the main show lot, while newer enthusiast vehicles will have designated showcase area, creating a dynamic and inclusive automotive experience.

Judging, Recognition, and Local Showcases

The judged show on Saturday will feature multiple award categories celebrating craftsmanship, originality, and standout presentation. In addition to traditional judging, Mackinaw Steel is also creating opportunities to highlight local vehicles, giving community members a social platform alongside regional and traveling participants.

Sunday’s “Awards & Roll Out” will provide a relaxed and celebratory finale as participants receive recognition and enjoy a scenic departure from Mackinaw City.

Why Register for Mackinaw Steel?

Participants will enjoy:

• A three-day event with flexible participation

• Strong promotion to car clubs and enthusiasts across the Midwest

• A welcoming, tourism-focused community

• Opportunities to connect with collectors, clubs, and spectators

• Founders recognition for early registrants

As a destination community known for hospitality and summer travel, Mackinaw City offers a wide range of lodging, dining, and attractions for participants turning their registration into a full weekend getaway.

Be a Founding Part of a New Tradition

The first year of any car show is special, and Mackinaw Steel is designed with growth in mind. Early registrants will be recognized as Founding Participants, helping establish a legacy event that celebrates automotive passion in the Straits area.

Whether you own a pristine classic, a restored truck, or a cherished collector vehicle, we invite you to bring it to Mackinaw City and be part of the inaugural Mackinaw Steel.

Registration is now open, and space is available to a limited number of vehicles. Secure your spot today and help launch one of Northern Michigan’s newest automotive traditions.
